newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Thai Airways eyes more cargo to Europe.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways eyes more cargo to Europe.

text.p: Thai Airways International Ltd s cargo division is considering stepping up its freighter capacity to Europe, a spokesman for the airline's cargo unit said on Wednesday.

Peter Sull, cargo and mail sales manager for Scandinavia and Finland, told Reuters by telephone from Copenhagen that talks were only in very early stages but that a number of possibilities were being discussed.
"It could be a freighter to London, or to Copenhagen, or in combination, or maybe in cooperation with (Scandinavian airline) SAS. But everything is still on the drawing table," he said.
"There will be more news this summer. Many ideas have been thrown on the table," he said.
